design.fit_set: ImageNetV2 MatchedFrequency calibration split, 5,000 images, 5 per class
design.primary_assessment_set: ImageNetV2 MatchedFrequency evaluation split, 5,000 images, 5 per class
design.seed_selection: none; all three seeds reported individually and as an equal-weight mean
design.secondary_benchmark: official ImageNet-1k validation, if pre-existing verified Stage 0A features are available; labelled non-independent and excluded from the primary decision

temperature.objective: mean negative log-likelihood on the 5,000-image calibration split only
temperature.compute_dtype: float64 for fitting; original logits retained as float32
temperature.convergence_rule: success must be true for every seed; otherwise report a technical failure and do not compute a confirmatory result
temperature.boundary_policy: report the constrained optimum and boundary flag; a boundary fit prevents confirmatory acceptance but is never silently clipped or widened

primary.name: mean_15bin_ECE_reduction
primary.definition: mean over seeds of ECE_15(raw) - ECE_15(calibrated) on the evaluation split
primary.binning: 15 equal-width confidence bins on [0,1]; membership lo < confidence <= hi; count-weighted

proper_scores.brier: multi-class sum of squared probability errors

classification.macro_top1: unweighted mean of available per-class accuracies
classification.prediction_agreement: exact Top-1 and Top-5 index-array agreement; zero mismatches required

secondary_calibration.reliability_diagram: 15 fixed bins with counts and Wilson 95% intervals

selective_prediction.interpretation: single-scalar temperature scaling is rank-preserving; raw and calibrated curves should coincide except for numerical ties

class_conditional.multiplicity_control: none because no per-class confirmatory claims are permitted
class_conditional.class_level_bootstrap: descriptive summary only; no 1,000-class significance claims

bootstrap.stratification: resample five images with replacement within each of the 1,000 classes
bootstrap.pairing: same resampled image indices for raw and calibrated predictions and for all three seeds

accept_h1_only_if_all: 95% class-stratified paired bootstrap interval excludes zero
no seed has an ECE increase greater than 0.005
every raw and calibrated Top-1 prediction is identical; zero mismatches
every raw and calibrated Top-5 index set is identical; zero mismatches
no seed has an NLL increase greater than 0.005
no seed has a Brier-score increase greater than 0.005
all three temperature fits report convergence success
no temperature fit is at a bound
decision_rule.interval_includes_zero_interpretation: calibration improvement not established; not proof of no effect
decision_rule.positive_but_small_interpretation: report effect size and interval; do not call statistical detectability practical importance

ties_and_invalid_values.tie_break: descending logit, then ascending class index (numpy lexsort)
ties_and_invalid_values.top1_top5_agreement: exact index-array equality after the frozen tie-break
ties_and_invalid_values.new_tie_or_order_change: treat as implementation failure and stop; do not report a calibration result

mandatory_limitations: five images per class in the primary assessment split
ImageNetV2 distribution shift relative to ImageNet-1k training data
Stage 0A image-level replay remains separately blocked
Stage 0B inference uses a separately pinned software environment because Stage 0A training-time timm/torchvision versions were not recorded
